ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels; white pixels are concentrated on the lateral lobes, while black pixels dominate the central and peduncle-adjacent regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white mottling forming large contiguous blocks on the outer third of both left and right lobes; central region is solid black interspersed with high-frequency, small-diameter white circular clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 55 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 1/6th of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing boundary; right lobe exhibits larger amplitude jagged peaks (15-20 pixels) compared to the left lobe; multiple small-scale valleys create a ragged linear profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the posterior trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning into sharp, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular rings and dots distributed across the central dark region; dense clusters of roughly circular white pixels are located specifically at the extreme distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple prominent, multi-directional linear rake marks visible as high-intensity white lines; longest marks are oriented diagonally on the lower-left and lower-right quadrants of the central black field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical calcified protrusions (barnacles) visible on the extreme distal tips; extensive linear rake mark scarring covering approximately 30% of the visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive white 'splatter' pattern on the leading edges of both lobes that contrasts sharply with the black central core.
